entities.name: Lady Evangela
entities.description: Legendary human cleric of ancient Dominaria, fascinated by rainbows; depicted riding a rainbow to the Mist Moon.

entities.name: Mist Moon
entities.description: True moon of Dominaria associated with Evangela.

entities.name: College of Lat-Nam
entities.description: Institution with a mosaic depicting Evangela.

entities.name: Brothers' War
entities.description: War after which Evangela's legacy persisted; she lived before it.

events.summary: Evangela, from her youth, is fascinated by rainbows and shares the peace they bring her.
events.quote: Since her youth, Evangela was fascinated by rainbows
